scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.test:golden: cmake -S engine/cpp -B /tmp/blokie-golden -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release >/dev/null && make -C /tmp/blokie-golden golden -j$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 4) >/dev/null && /tmp/blokie-golden/golden --file engine/golden/golden.json
scripts.measure:golden: cmake -S engine/cpp -B /tmp/blokie-golden -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release >/dev/null && make -C /tmp/blokie-golden golden_measure -j$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 4) >/dev/null && /tmp/blokie-golden/golden_measure --file engine/golden/golden.json
